provenance.mock_notice: Decider decisions evaluated from real GPU Tesla T4 cache.

definitions.premature_interruption: Action RESPOND executed while speaker is mid-thought. Numerator = premature count, Denominator = total turns (N=324).
definitions.unnecessary_wait: Action RESPOND executed > 800ms after speech ended for finished turns. Numerator = delayed finished turns, Denominator = finished turns (N=155). Global 800ms threshold.
definitions.response_delay: Elapsed ms from true speech end to agent response, evaluated exclusively over completed turns (N=155).
definitions.accuracy: Turn-level match between predicted binary action and ground truth over all turns (N=324).
definitions.cluster_bootstrap: Non-parametric two-stage cluster bootstrap (B=1000 resamples: sample users with replacement, then sample turns within user with replacement).

findings.decider_name: Strands Decider 2B (301ms GPU, cache-measured on T4)

operating_points.dominance_finding: Fixed timeouts and text heuristic dominate Decider at both operating points: At Point A (equal delay budget <= 800ms), Text Heuristic achieves 800ms delay vs Decider 1501ms with comparable cut-in rate. At Point B (premature budget <= 5%), Fixed 950ms and Text Heuristic 950ms achieve 950ms delay with 3.3% and 2.5% cut-ins, whereas Decider waited 2200ms (+1250ms slower) to eliminate cut-ins.
